S0131.reason: Since the brass knuckles caused the same harm as a bare fist, the consent to a fistfight still covers the resulting injury, so the best argument for rejecting consent is that the harm would have been identical.

S0004.reason: Stomas are ideally sited within an abdominal crease to allow a well-fitting appliance and concealment.

S1333.reason: Prior to the UN Charter, international law generally prohibited armed force except in limited circumstances such as self-defense.
